answer: Admission auction stops bulk fakes. Each round offers 200 slots; agents bid, only the top 200 enter, losers refunded. No agent can wander in and claim many slots: each extra identity needs a winning bid. In a meadow of applicants, a farmer wanting 100 slots must win 100 bids: at 40 credits each, that costs 4,000 credits for rewards worth 800, so it loses money. An honest agent pays once, a copper deposit as bond, and keeps undiluted rewards.
